packageRules.description: Group all Pangolin role dependencies together
Pangolin's Docker tags are prefixed with ee- (e.g. ee-1.21.0); teach Renovate to parse them as semver so EE updates are detected
Group all Immich role dependencies together
flip-planning is our own image: take digest updates as soon as they are published, no 1 day cooldown, and automerge once the lint workflow passes (merging on main triggers the deploy workflow)

customManagers.description: Track the flip-planning image pinned in the Ansible role defaults (plain var, no manager covers it)
Track Traefik experimental plugin versions in the Pangolin static config (e.g. fosrl/badger); no built-in manager covers Traefik plugins

hostRules.description: Read-only PAT so Renovate can look up digests of the private flip-planning package. GHCR_TOKEN is uploaded as an App Secret in the Mend Developer Portal, not stored here
